Use for requested character animation when Blender is unavailable or Eclipse explicitly chosen. Respect exclusions/Blender-only requests. Verify Studio Edit mode, exact rig, installed Eclipse and actual desktop-control permissions before UI actions.

Use scripts/ helpers, not upstream/scripts/: original helper overwrites same-name sequences. Do not overwrite unrelated or Eclipse-baked animations.
